video_caption: The video displays a static image on a bright yellow background featuring the logo for "Nick Jr. Baby Curious Buddies." On the left, a friendly-looking orange dinosaur stands facing left, with a light blue baby dinosaur hatching from a white egg nestled in its back. The egg is labeled with "Nick Jr." in blue text on the top and "Baby" in blue text on the bottom. To the right, the words "Curious Buddies" are presented in a playful, cartoonish font. "Curious" is in light blue, and the apostrophe and dots over the 'i's form a small cartoon face, while "BUDDIES" is in light purple. Both parts of "Curious Buddies" are outlined in white. At 0:04, black text appears below the main logo, first stating "Available Fall 2004" and then "on VHS and DVD !", indicating the release information for the product. The scene remains static for the duration of the segment.

The video features various babies and toddlers interacting with colorful, dog-like hand puppets against a bright blue background. Initially, a baby in a pink outfit is laughing in a white crocheted chair while playing with green and pink puppets. This is followed by a toddler boy in a plaid shirt affectionately hugging and kissing a pink puppet, then another toddler boy in blue overalls standing and happily clapping his hands while surrounded by pink, blue, and yellow puppets. A toddler girl with blonde curly hair in a pink top is seen interacting with pink and orange puppets, kissing one of them, and then smiling brightly. Another baby boy with light red hair is shown laughing as he's surrounded by four colorful puppets: two pink, one orange, and one green. A different toddler girl with blonde hair, also in a pink top, giggles alongside a pink puppet. A toddler with dark hair in a white shirt smiles while engaging with four puppets of varying colors. The initial baby in the white chair reappears, continuing to laugh amidst the puppets. The toddler boy in the plaid shirt returns, kissing a pink puppet, followed by a toddler girl in a red shirt, laughing joyfully with four puppets. The blonde-haired toddler girl is shown in a close-up, kissing a pink puppet. The video concludes with a bright yellow screen displaying the "NICK JR. Baby Curious BUDDIES" logo, which features an orange dinosaur and a baby blue dinosaur hatching from an egg. Below the logo, the website "www.NickJr.com/Baby" is shown, along with the copyright text: "© 2004 Viacom International Inc. All Rights Reserved. Nickelodeon, Nick Jr, Nick Jr. Baby and all related titles, logos and characters are trademarks of Viacom International Inc." The screen then fades to black.

The video opens with a large blue paw print covering part of the screen, behind which a man in a green shirt (Steve) looks surprised while a red telephone rests on a small table, all set against a yellow wall adorned with hearts. Blue, the blue dog, is then shown in various scenes, including looking curious near a green tree and a blue star-themed clock, interacting with an orange puppet and a light green puppy puppet, and playing with a red jukebox-like object. Blue then speaks directly to the viewer, saying, "I can talk to you. Can you believe it?" and "You're my best friend," highlighting the new talking feature. Blue is also seen playing with a large purple chest that has eyes, drinking from green cups, and wearing a red hat with a small doll. The scene shifts to Blue and a light green puppy puppet next to an easel displaying a drawing of a swing and a red heart, followed by Blue in a room with colorful balloons and interacting with a golden carriage toy. The Blue's Clues characters are shown around the chest and jukebox again, with Blue holding a notepad and excitedly opening its mouth. Blue is then seen holding a green cup, saying, "My juice is blue. What color is your juice?" The commercial then transitions to show two VHS/DVD cases for "Blue Talks" on a blue, bubbly background, with text appearing that reads, "Available Now" and "Where Videos & DVDs Are Sold," along with the Paramount logo and copyright information: "© 2003 Viacom International Inc. All Rights Reserved. Nickelodeon, Nick Jr., Blue's Clues and all related titles, logos and characters are trademarks of Viacom International Inc. TM, (R) & Copyright by Paramount Pictures. Pictures are trademarks of Paramount Pictures." Additional text, "Plus, look for special DVD features from Nick Jr. and Paramount," appears before Blue and friends are seen briefly again, leading to a black screen.

The video opens with an animated pirate ship sailing on a blue sea with Dora, Boots, and other characters on board, as a pink dolphin swims alongside. Text in purple and pink letters appears over the ship, reading: "Dora's Pirate Adventure!". The scene then shifts to Dora (wearing a pink shirt, orange shorts, and a purple backpack) and Boots (a white monkey in red boots) standing beside a small wooden boat on a grassy riverbank, with Dora gesturing with outstretched arms. Next, Dora, holding a map, and Boots are seen on a wooden dock with a treasure chest and three small pig characters dressed as pirates in the background, by a calm blue sea. Following this, Diego, a boy with brown hair, is shown swinging on a rope aboard a ship, holding a spotted jaguar cub. Dora and Boots are then seen running and leaping over a log on a vibrant green hill. A golden, glowing circular portal appears over a blue river, expanding to reveal Dora's smiling face framed within a golden porthole. Above her, white text states, "Only on VHS and DVD!". The video concludes with the porthole fading away, revealing a tranquil blue ocean with a small, tree-covered island in the distance.

The video opens with Dora, wearing a pink shirt, orange shorts, and a purple backpack, standing on a wooden dock alongside her friends Boots, Benny, Diego, Isa, Tico, Baby Jaguar, and a green alligator-like character, all looking excited under a clear blue sky. Dora then appears on the bow of a golden and yellow boat, raising her arms excitedly as it sails across the wavy blue ocean. The scene transitions to a wider shot of the boat, now with a white sail, carrying all the characters cheering with raised arms. Next, Dora and Boots are back on a wooden dock, looking surprised as three small pink pirate pigs wearing bandanas and a pirate hat grab a blue treasure chest and make off with it, leaving the chest further down the dock. The screen then displays the title "Dora's Pirate Adventure!" (English) on a sandy beach with palm trees and a half-buried treasure chest, followed by the text "Available on VHS and DVD!" (English) underneath, along with the Nick Jr., Paramount, and DVD logos. The video concludes with Dora and Boots happily running and dancing on a dirt path through a vibrant green landscape.

The video segment opens with three VHS/DVD covers for the show "Oswald" displayed on a brightly lit stage with red curtains, accompanied by the text "Available Now." The scene then transitions to Oswald, a blue octopus character, waving on a stage, surrounded by musical notes and flowers, with a grand piano in the background as an audience of various cartoon characters (a rabbit, a penguin, a butterfly-like creature, a flower-person, and a robot-like creature) cheer and clap. Oswald is then shown playing a small white piano with a yellow star on it, while a yellow star-shaped character sings into a microphone next to a grand piano. Finally, Oswald is seen on a sidewalk with its dachshund companion, a pink butterfly-like creature, a yellow flower-person, and a black penguin, happily interacting, when the video experiences a brief glitch and bleep censor at 0:14, cutting off a sound, then resumes with Oswald smiling.

The video showcases various animated scenes featuring Oswald, a blue octopus-like character, and his friends. It opens with Oswald in a park, wearing a white chef's hat and looking through binoculars, accompanied by his hot-dog-shaped dog, Weenie. The scene then transitions to Oswald, Weenie, a penguin, and a yellow flower-like character enjoying a swim in a light blue body of water. The flower character is then shown surfing on a surfboard. Subsequent scenes include Oswald watering a plant in a garden with Weenie, and then back to floating in the water. A yellow background with red curtains appears, highlighting a VHS tape titled "OSWALD BEST BUDDIES," with the tagline "Spend some time with Oswald and his friends in these four super stories!" The video then shows Oswald playing a red piano indoors with two penguins and Weenie, followed by a picnic scene in a park with all the characters, including a snowman and a squirrel. The final scene features the yellow flower character hugging the penguin under a tree.

The video features a cast of colorful cartoon characters in a vibrant, stylized world. It begins in a park setting, showing a blue octopus (Oswald) with a small brown dachshund (Weenie), a black and white penguin (Henry), and a yellow flower (Daisy) walking. They are soon joined by a white snowman, a pink butterfly (Madam Butterfly), and a pink caterpillar (Katrina). Title cards then introduce each character with their name on a Hollywood-style marquee: "OSWALD" (the octopus waving, saying "Hello. I'm Oswald. It's a pleasure to meet you."), "WEENIE" (the dachshund barking), "HENRY" (the penguin in sunglasses, asking "Is all this from me?"), "DAISY" (the flower holding a balloon, saying "Ring-a-ding-ding"), and "MADAM BUTTERFLY & KATRINA" (the caterpillar saying "Baby, baby"). The setting shifts to a beach where Oswald, Henry, Daisy, Weenie, the snowman, a seal, a pumpkin-headed character, and a robot are gathered. The video concludes with quick glimpses of other characters: two egg-shaped figures, a white rabbit holding a pineapple, a tree-like character and a pumpkin-headed character both wearing sunglasses, and a character in red cap and blue overalls standing next to a grand piano.

The video begins with an animated scene featuring Oswald, a blue octopus-like character with a black bowler hat, sitting on a pink sofa and watching a green television. A small brown hot dog-shaped dog lies on a green rug in the yellow-walled room, which also has a brown door. The scene transitions to a stage with red curtains opening to reveal three VHS/DVD cases for the children's show "Oswald," titled "Outdoors with Oswald," "Best Buddies," and "Welcome to Big City." Another animated segment shows Oswald spotlighted on a wooden stage, with the hot dog-shaped dog nearby, while a tall, rectangular white character with a red bowtie and blue hat (Henry the Penguin) gestures towards Oswald next to a grand piano. The scene returns to the VHS/DVD cases, displaying "Available Now" text, along with "Paramount," "Nick Jr.," and "DVD" logos and copyright information from 2003. Red curtains then close, and the screen goes black before the Paramount Pictures logo appears, featuring a mountain against a dramatic sky. This logo transforms into a circular frame enclosing animated characters Charlie Brown bending over a blue piano-like object and Snoopy, wearing aviator goggles and a red scarf, dancing beside him, all against the mountain background. The background then changes to plain white for the animated characters, followed by a live-action shot of two young boys sitting on a blue cushion against a yellow background; the younger boy with blond hair wears a red jacket and plaid shirt, while the older boy with brown hair wears a yellow polo shirt and has his arm around the younger boy, both smiling.

The video opens with two young boys sitting on a blue surface against a yellow background, both with their hands raised and expressing playful enthusiasm; the boy on the left wears a red jacket over a plaid shirt, while the boy on the right wears a yellow long-sleeved shirt. This transitions to a close-up of a young boy in a white long-sleeved shirt, making a thoughtful chewing expression, followed by a close-up of a young East Asian girl with pigtails in a red and yellow striped shirt, smiling broadly. The scene then changes to an animation of Charlie Brown, wearing his iconic yellow and black zig-zag shirt, sliding across a field of yellow autumn leaves, holding a white object. He then sits up and smiles at Lucy Van Pelt, who is standing next to him in a blue dress, holding an American football, all set against a background of yellow leaves and a white sky.

The video begins with Snoopy smiling and resting his chin on his paw while sitting at a table with scissors, red paper scraps, and a red sheet of paper. The scene then transitions to Snoopy as the "Red Baron" wearing a green aviator helmet and red scarf, sitting on his doghouse, with the text "2 NEW PEANUTS CLASSICS" displayed in a wavy banner above him against a yellow background. Following this, a brief animation shows Woodstock and another bird in a tree nest, as an item, possibly a birdhouse, is dropped near them, and Snoopy flies by. A new title card appears for "A CHARLIE BROWN VALENTINE," showcasing its VHS/DVD cover with Snoopy and a red wagon, marked with a "NEW" starburst. The scene shifts to Sally Brown, in a blue polka-dot dress, standing in a classroom decorated with hearts and a blackboard reading "PARTY TODAY." Linus van Pelt, in a red striped shirt, is then shown walking with a large red heart-shaped box. Sally is seen happily kissing Linus on the cheek, who looks surprised, holding the heart box. The video transitions to Charlie Brown, in a yellow zig-zag shirt and baseball cap, holding a glove on a baseball field, with Snoopy blowing on the glove and a baseball in the air. Another title card appears for "LUCY MUST BE TRADED, CHARLIE BROWN," featuring its VHS/DVD cover and a "NEW" starburst, showing Charlie Brown catching a baseball. Lucy van Pelt, wearing a blue shirt and baseball cap, then confronts Charlie Brown on the baseball field, where he appears to be complaining. Finally, Snoopy playfully snatches Charlie Brown's baseball cap, jumps up, and a baseball flies off, surprising both Lucy and Charlie Brown.

The video showcases various scenes from classic Peanuts animated specials available on DVD and video. It opens with Lucy (in a wizard hat) and Snoopy bobbing for apples, followed by Charlie Brown and Lucy outdoors, then Sally amidst floating hearts, and Charlie Brown pitching. Subsequent scenes depict Halloween costumes and Linus and Sally looking at the full moon for "It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown." A young girl speaks, emphasizing belief in the Great Pumpkin. Peppermint Patty pulls Snoopy in a wagon, and Charlie Brown receives a Valentine from her in "Be My Valentine, Charlie Brown." Lucy and Snoopy (carrying a basket) walk in a field with text reading "IT'S THE EASTER BEAGLE, CHARLIE BROWN", followed by Lucy, Sally, and Linus holding eggs, and a real beagle. Snoopy dances with rabbits, and Peanuts characters enjoy an outdoor Thanksgiving meal, while a young boy watches. Snoopy, in a chef's hat, cooks toast in a kitchen, then grills for friends. The next scene shows Charlie Brown and Sally admiring a decorated doghouse under a starry sky, with text "A CHARLIE BROWN CHRISTMAS," followed by Lucy arguing with Snoopy while holding a script, and a young girl laughing. Charlie Brown stands sadly by a megaphone, and finally, all the Peanuts characters dance on a stage.

The video begins with an advertisement for Peanuts DVDs. The first scene shows various Peanuts characters including Lucy, Linus, and Sally on a stage with a large double bass, as the text "EACH DVD COMES WITH BONUS EPISODES" appears at the bottom. This text reappears in the next two scenes: Linus lying on autumn leaves with a lollipop while Charlie Brown stands by a large leaf pile, and then an animation of leaves scattering. Charlie Brown is next seen smiling and looking up, with his hands under his chin. The scene transitions to Snoopy disguised as a furry monster, surrounded by several Peanuts DVD/VHS covers including "A Charlie Brown Thanksgiving" and "It's The Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown," with the text "COLLECT THEM ALL ON DVD & VIDEO" displayed above, along with the Paramount logo. Other quick animated clips show Charlie Brown jumping over Linus on a baseball mound, Snoopy covered in candies from a gumball machine, and Snoopy, Sally, and another character dancing in a festive Christmas shop. Following this, a blue screen with sparkling white dots announces "I Want a Dog for Christmas, Charlie Brown" and then "COMING HOLIDAY 2004 ON DVD & VIDEO." A black screen momentarily appears before transitioning to the 2002-2004 Paramount Pictures Home Entertainment logo, featuring the iconic mountain surrounded by stars, with "Paramount" and "A VIACOM COMPANY" written below, which then fades into a gold "FEATURE PRESENTATION" title on a purple gradient background. This is followed by a dark blue screen with repeating Paramount logos in the background, displaying a licensing notice in white capital letters: "LICENSED ONLY FOR NON COMMERCIAL PRIVATE EXHIBITION IN HOMES. ANY PUBLIC PERFORMANCE OTHER USE OR COPYING IS STRICTLY PROHIBITED. ALL RIGHTS UNDER COPYRIGHT RESERVED." After a brief black screen, the 2002-2011 Paramount Pictures logo animation unfolds, showing shooting stars falling through clouds in a night sky, one star growing larger and forming the mountain peak with the "Paramount" text and surrounding stars, and "A VIACOM COMPANY" at the bottom. The video concludes with the Nick Jr. "Frogs" bumper, where two cartoon frogs, one orange and one blue, croak "NICK" and "JR" respectively while sitting on lily pads, forming the network's logo.
